#!/usr/bin/env bash
# P106B_Stage4fnWe_native595_broad_float704: same frozen22528/four passes704; actual completed Native595 parent only.
# Original SFT math/replay5632/optimizer retained. No assets downloaded, stdin, retag or old overwrite.
# Costs and both pending arms must fit before training; child PASS is not answer quality.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
source scripts/shell/tinylm_env.sh
python_bin="$(tinylm_python)"
if [[ $# -ne 0 ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' '[STOP] This immutable stage accepts no positional arguments.' >&2
    exit 8
fi
run_stamp="$(date +%H%M%S)"
log="test_result/101_log_$(date +%Y%m%d)_P106B_Stage4fnWe_native595_broad_float704_${run_stamp}.txt"
if [[ -e "$log" || -L "$log" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' '[STOP] Existing raw is preserved; use a new stage.' >&2
    exit 8
fi
"$python_bin" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --name P106B_Stage4fnWe_native595_broad_float704_"$run_stamp" --num 101 --note 'Actual595 parent completed4543 only; same Broad22528/4pass704 and old597995000 TRAIN/replay5632. micro8 accum16 seq1024 checkpoint-on/L0/Adam5e-5/Muon2e-4 WD0 clip1/default compile. Parent report and normalized descriptor SHA are separate. Original44 controller/core9 bodies retained; active14400/eval3600/record600, train21st14KST/authority17KST. Both costs and all pending estimates required; no float-only budget fallback. Mode train cap3600s; train cap is bounded but no timing guarantee, current budget rechecked. Closed worker plus readonly verifier required for cost/train. All public files below20MB; source16/max17 history answers are not general3turn proof.'
"$python_bin" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --name P106B_Stage4fnWe_native595_broad_float704_"$run_stamp" --num 101 -- "$python_bin" -B -X utf8 scripts/diag_p106b_native595_broad.py --mode train --arm float --max-wall-sec 3600 --execute
